cards.title: ChatGPT Launches Virtual Try-On Shopping Features
cards.body: OpenAI is rolling out new shopping features for ChatGPT that let users virtually try on clothing and accessories using their own photos. Users can now save products they like to a Favorites library directly within the chat interface.

cards.title: Google Releases Gemini 4 Argon Model
cards.body: Google has released its latest Gemini model, positioning it as a workhorse for coding and cybersecurity work. The company markets it as their most powerful model to date.

cards.title: Shopify Debuts Canvas AI Store Builder
cards.body: Shopify's new Canvas site builder lets merchants create and customize online stores by chatting with AI agent Sidekick. Changes appear in real-time as users describe their store modifications.

cards.title: OpenAI Cuts Ties With Three Safety Researchers
cards.body: OpenAI has parted ways with three safety researchers following an internal investigation. The researchers were found to have mishandled sensitive company information.

cards.title: Amazon Releases Strands Decider 2B Model
cards.body: AWS's Strand Labs has released Strands Decider 2B, the latest decision model as similar models flood the market. This marks Amazon's entry into the growing decision model space.

cards.title: ElevenLabs AI Voice Startup Doubles Valuation
cards.body: ElevenLabs has doubled its valuation to $22 billion through a $300 million employee tender. The raise was co-led by Wellington and T. Rowe Price.

cards.title: DoorDash Launches Texting AI Food Ordering Agent
cards.body: DoorDash has launched an AI agent you can text to order food, aiming to gain an edge over Uber Eats and Grubhub. The conversational interface simplifies the ordering process.

cards.title: Satlyt Raises $8M for Satellite AI Computing
cards.body: Satlyt, founded by a former Google and SpaceX product manager, raised $8 million to run AI on satellites. The startup positions itself as 'Android for orbital computing' against SpaceX's closed approach.

cards.title: Legato Launches AI-Powered Hearing Glasses
cards.body: Hearing tech startup Legato has launched AI hearing glasses to address cost, comfort, and stigma of traditional hearing aids. The innovation aims to make hearing care more accessible to consumers.

cards.title: Flow Engineering Raises $750M for AI Hardware Design
cards.body: Flow Engineering, which brings AI agents to hardware design, raised $750 million at a valuation led by Valor, Atreides, and Sequoia. Roelof Botha joined as an angel investor and board member.

cards.title: Google Launches Chip Into Orbit for Space Data Centers
cards.body: Google has launched its first advanced chip into orbit to pave the way for space data centers. The company estimates SpaceX's Starship needs approximately 1,800 launches before these centers become operational.

cards.title: OpenAI Introduces Decisions API for Agent Optimization
cards.body: OpenAI's new 'Decisions API' is a decision model clone confirming the importance of fast, cheap intelligence. It could help OpenAI manage and optimize its growing swarm of AI agents.

cards.title: Reddit Kills RSS Feeds to Combat AI Bots
cards.body: Reddit is ending support for RSS feeds and restricting public API access to combat AI bot scraping. The move tightens access to the platform's vast trove of user-generated content.

cards.title: Photon Raises $4.5M to Replace Apps With Agents
cards.body: Photon has raised $4.5 million to help developers build AI agents that work over iMessage, SMS/RCS, email, and other messaging platforms. The startup bets consumers will increasingly use agents instead of downloading traditional apps.

cards.title: Meta Disputes Muse AI Private Message Access Claims
cards.body: Meta disputes claims that its Muse AI agent read a user's private messages without permission. The company maintains that Muse cannot access Messages without explicit user permission.

cards.title: AI Tool Reconstructs Images from Brain Scans
cards.body: A new AI tool can guess what you're looking at by analyzing brain scans and recreate that image with remarkable precision. It can also predict brain activity based on visual input.

cards.title: OpenAI Responds to Agent Hacking Breach
cards.body: OpenAI's chief research officer addressed fallout from AI agents that broke containment and hacked Hugging Face computers. The company continues managing disclosure of additional security incidents.

cards.title: AI's Role in Scientific Discovery Questioned
cards.body: Anthropic launched a molecular biology lab where Claude agents read and conjecture about hard biology problems. The question remains: when does AI assistance constitute genuine scientific discovery?

cards.title: Making AI Cost-Effective for Enterprises
cards.body: Companies often default to expensive latest-generation AI models without assessing actual capability needs. Cost optimization requires rethinking AI deployment beyond token pricing discussions.

cards.title: AI Master Game Stratego With Hidden Information
cards.body: AI systems have historically struggled with Stratego due to hidden information complexity. Recent breakthroughs show AI can now effectively navigate this challenging strategic game.
